description: Reserved Matters Application to approve details of Scale, Appearance, Layout, Access and Landscaping in accordance with Condition B4 of Outline Planning Permission reference 18/03506/OUT (granted on 18th November 2020) in relation to Phase 2. THIS APPLICATION IS ACCOMPANYING A STATEMENT OF CONFORMITY TO THE PREVIOUSLY APPROVED ENVIRONMENTAL STATEMENT UNDER THE TOWN AND COUNTRY PLANNING (ENVIRONMENTAL IMPACT ASSESSMENT) REGULATIONS 2017 (AS AMENDED) THIS APPLICATION AFFECTS THE SETTINGS OF LISTED BUILDINGS
